components.purpose: Attach explicit evidence to one visual protagonist.
components.interaction: Optional disclosure only; base canvas is non-interactive.
components.keyboard: not-interactive unless action is present; action uses native button or link
components.responsive_behavior: Evidence moves below protagonist under 390px; no overlap at 200% zoom.
components.accessibility_semantics: figure with figcaption; decorative marks hidden from assistive technology
forbidden_compositions: source contour plus transaction chip plus viewport rails
validation_rules: previewed in Web A, poster A and real-image previews

components.purpose: Name one observation, value and unit next to its referent.
components.responsive_behavior: Wrap label before value; never truncate sign or unit.
components.accessibility_semantics: group with a readable label-value sequence
content_constraints: Value must be plausible for depicted object/event
Source note required for external data
allowed_compositions: one to five callouts per proof canvas
validation_rules: previewed across Web A/B and slide evidence page

components.purpose: Frame a relationship using a theme-specific datum without copying source rails or cuts.
components.keyboard: not-interactive; must not clip descendant focus
components.responsive_behavior: Collapse offset to 8px at 320px; keep continuous geometry.
components.accessibility_semantics: decorative boundary hidden from assistive technology
content_constraints: Boundary must express alignment or grouping

components.purpose: Expose the single prioritized action on a surface.
components.interaction: Navigate with anchor when destination exists; use button for in-place action.
components.keyboard: Enter activates links; Enter/Space activates buttons; disabled controls are not focusable.
components.responsive_behavior: Minimum 44×44 CSS pixels; label wraps at 200% zoom.
components.accessibility_semantics: native anchor or button with accessible name
validation_rules: previewed in Web A/B, Carousel CTA and Slide CTA

components.purpose: Advance one stage of a medium-aware explanation-to-proof sequence.
components.keyboard: Sequence controls use native buttons with current state announced.
components.responsive_behavior: Slide type remains projection-sized; Carousel type remains social-sized; web reflows to one column.
components.accessibility_semantics: section with heading; current step uses aria-current when interactive
forbidden_compositions: identical layout and density on all stages
validation_rules: previewed as eight individual Carousel pages and eight individual Slides

components.reason: High-specificity brand motif; not a reusable Agent contract.
Semantic attachment mechanism is portable, but the source-like merchant chip composition is not.
Source motion signature and reduced-motion burden exceed current validation.
